components.transformer: QwenImageTransformer2DModel (60 QwenImageTransformerBlock, 24 heads x 128, joint dim 3584 -> 3072)

A_hf.golden: QwenImageEditPipeline.__call__(image, prompt, negative_prompt=' ', true_cfg_scale=4.0, num_inference_steps=50, latents=<shared initial noise>, output_type='pt') in float32 on CPU

B_bringup.note: models/demos/qwen_image_edit does not exist. This model was brought up as three components, and their bring-up folders ARE Source B: models/demos/qwen_image_edit_text_encoder (mesh 2x4 TP=4xDP=2), models/tt_dit/pipelines/qwen_image_edit_vae (1x8 TP=8), models/tt_dit/pipelines/qwen_image_edit_transformer (1x8 TP=8).
B_bringup.graduation_rule: status NEW with a _stubs/<name>.py.last_good_native or .last_good_sharded snapshot; the live _stubs/<name>.py equals that snapshot (verified by byte compare for all 25).

graduated_modules.verified_by: bringup_status.json status==NEW and a last_good snapshot exists; the live stub equalled that snapshot when this run started (byte compare). Stubs this run changed were re-verified with their own tests/pcc tests on their graduated topologies: 40/40 pass, lowest qwen_image_decoder3d 0.9973.

vision_patch_embed.role: patch features 1176 -> 1280, the first op of the vision tower

v_l_vision_block.role: each of the 32 vision blocks (window / full attention)

vision_transformer_pretrained_model.role: the vision tower container: patch_embed -> window reorder -> 32 blocks -> merger -> reverse order; composed of the three stubs above

v_l_decoder_layer.role: each of the 28 LM decoder layers

language_model_layers_0_mlp.role: the SwiGLU MLP inside every decoder layer

v_l_text_model.role: the LM container: 28 decoder layers + final norm, composed of the two stubs above

qwen_image_encoder3d.role: VAE encode of the condition image (composed of the block stubs below)

qwen_image_decoder3d.role: VAE decode of the final latent (composed of the block stubs below)

zero_pad2d.role: the right/bottom zero pad before each stride-2 downsample conv

qwen_image_upsample.role: the spatial x2 upsample inside each decoder up-resample

non_graduated_used_as_glue.mlp: ADAPT (last_good_sharded): quant_conv 1x1x1 (and the same port for post_quant_conv)

qwen_timestep_proj_embeddings.role: temb = timestep_embedding(timesteps(t)), composed of the two stubs above

qwen_embed_rope.role: 3-axis RoPE tables for [noise latent, condition latent] + text

non_graduated_used_as_glue.patch_embed: ADAPT (last_good_native): img_in; the same Linear port builds txt_in
non_graduated_used_as_glue.attention: REUSE (last_good_sharded): joint attention inside each block (the block body uses it)

not_used_and_why.text_encoder.decoder_head (lm_head): ADAPT, not graduated. The edit pipeline takes hidden_states[-1] and never computes logits.
not_used_and_why.REUSE/ADAPT duplicates (text_encoder att: not graduated work products; each is the same class as, or a thinner wrapper of, a graduated module above

task_heads.name: image_edit
task_heads.input: PIL image(s) + edit instruction(s). The HF VaeImageProcessor resizes to calculate_dimensions(area, aspect) and preprocesses to [-1,1] for the VAE. The HF Qwen2VLProcessor builds input_ids / attention_mask / pixel_values / image_grid_thw from the pipeline prompt template, for the prompt and for negative_prompt=' '. Initial noise comes from the per-sample torch.Generator(seed) via diffusers randn_tensor.
task_heads.output: edited image tensor [B, 3, H, W] in [0,1] (HF postprocess output_type='pt'); the demo also saves PNGs
chain: vision_encode: vision_transformer_pretrained_model(vision_patch_embed -> 32 x v_l_vision_block -> v_l_patch_merger) on the resized condition image

text_encode: token_embed(ids) with the image embeddings spliced at the <|image_pad|> run -> v_l_text_model (28 x v_l_decoder_layer, each with language_model_layers_0_mlp; row-staged 14 + 14) -> drop the 64 template tokens -> prompt_embeds (+mask). The prompts and negatives run as one 64-sequence batch.
vae_encode: qwen_image_encoder3d -> quant_conv -> mode (first z_dim channels) -> (x - mean)/std -> 2x2 pack -> image_latents

denoise x num_inference_steps: cat[latents, image_latents] -> img_in; txt_norm -> txt_in; qwen_timestep_proj_embeddings(t/1000); rope = qwen_embed_rope([(1,h,w),(1,h,w)], txt_len) -> 60 x qwen_image_transformer_block -> ada_layer_norm_continuous -> proj_out -> noise_pred[:, :S_latent]; same for uncond; true-CFG combine + norm rescale; flow-match Euler step
vae_decode: unpack -> x*std + mean -> post_quant_conv -> qwen_image_decoder3d -> clamp(-1,1) -> (x+1)/2
task_heads.agent: one agent (a single call; no other call shares modules)

pass_definition.gate1_native: every routed graduated stub is ttnn (no torch compute in its forward). The sharded bodies stay sharded: ShardTensorToMesh plus all_reduce/all_gather, with the collectives extended from the 1x8 row to both axes of the 2x4 mesh; never replicated.
pass_definition.gate2_invoked: each of the 25 graduated modules records >=1 call during the real image_edit forward. Counters sit on the stub instances inside the chain; there is no coverage sweep.
pass_definition.gate3_pcc: final image PCC >= 0.99 vs the HF golden, per sample, for all 32 samples. Also asserted: PCC of the last-step latent. Printed on every run: 'e2e PCC=<min over samples>'.
pass_definition.host_free: host_op_selftest(): zero non-benign aten ops inside the observed forward (encoded inputs -> image)
pass_definition.trace: trace_capture_selftest(): per stage, capture / execute / release; output PCC vs eager

validation_metric.primary: PCC(tt_image[b], hf_image[b]) >= 0.99 for every b in 0..31, over the full image tensor (no crop)
secondary: per-stage PCC printed (prompt_embeds, image_latents, step-0 noise_pred) for diagnosis
validation_metric.not_applicable: rendered-signal scores (WER/MOS) apply to audio output with a rate; this output is an image tensor, so PCC is the gate

behavioral_proof.real_input: 4 real photos from models/sample_data, each cut into 8 distinct square crops -> 32 distinct condition images, 32 distinct instructions, 32 distinct seeds
behavioral_proof.independence_check: assert the 32 TT outputs are pairwise distinct, and each matches its own golden better than any other sample's golden
behavioral_proof.no_injection: each stage consumes the previous TT stage's device tensor; the golden is used only for the final comparison

horizon.kind: diffusion (no autoregressive decode; no stop token)
horizon.steps: num_inference_steps = 50, the QwenImageEditPipeline default; the same schedule (sigmas linspace(1, 1/50, 50) + dynamic shift mu(image_seq_len)) on both sides. The whole schedule runs; nothing is truncated.

resolution.area: 256*256 for the gate. The HF pipeline hard-codes calculate_dimensions(1024*1024) for the condition image; the golden runs the same pipeline with that target area overridden to 256*256, which gives 256x256 for square inputs (512 image tokens + ~100 text tokens).
resolution.why: The fp32 CPU golden costs ~10 s per sample-forward at 612 tokens, measured this run (B=4 took 38.9 s). 32 samples x 2 (CFG) x 50 steps is ~8.6 h at 256^2; 1024^2 (~9600 tokens) would be ~15x larger and quadratic in attention, so it is out of reach for 32 goldens. The demo exposes --area for other sizes.

batch.axis: leading axis of every tensor; the denoise loop runs one program per step for all 32 (cond and uncond as two B=32 transformer calls)
batch.dp: the text encoder rows split cond/uncond (64 sequences = 2 rows x 32)

hardware.box: T3K, 8 x Wormhole, opened as a 2x4 mesh

weights_estimate_per_chip_GB.note: estimate from parameter counts (20.4B/8, 7.1B/4 excluding lm_head, bf16), NOT measured; checked against the 10.5 GB usable figure (the CCL axis is in play)

weights_measured_per_chip_GB.note: measured this run from ttnn buffer reports (max over chips, DRAM buffers), 2x4 mesh
weights_measured_per_chip_GB.ceiling_used: 10.5 GB usable per chip with a CCL axis in play (registered figure)

self_validation_plan: 1. Build the HF golden once (fp32 CPU, B=32, 50 steps) and cache it with its inputs and per-step latents under models/demos/qwen_image_edit/_golden/
2. Stage bring-up on device in order vision -> text -> vae_encode -> one transformer step -> vae_decode; compare each against the golden intermediates at B=2, then at B=32
3. Re-run the modified stubs' own tests/pcc tests (captured B=1 inputs) to prove the batch generalisation and the 2x4 collectives did not regress them
4. Full e2e test at B=32: Gate 1 (static and runtime scan for torch compute in the stubs), Gate 2 (invocation counters), Gate 3 (PCC per sample); print e2e PCC before the assert
5. host_op_selftest and trace_capture_selftest per stage; build_pipeline(layers=2) proves the depth knob changes the op count

decisions.mesh: one 2x4 mesh (T3K). The text encoder needs TP=4 (4 kv heads) on the 4 columns. The transformer keeps TP=8 over all 8 chips, with its collectives run on axis 1 then axis 0. The VAE is W-parallel over the 4 columns.
decisions.text_encoder_rows: The graduated TP=4 x DP=2 layout replicates the 28-layer LM on both rows: 4.72 GB/chip, which with the 5.36 GB transformer is past the 10.5 GB ceiling. So the LM is row-staged: layers 0-13 on row 0, 14-27 on row 1, same TP=4 split per layer, exact all_gather hand-off between rows. The 32 prompts and 32 negatives run as one 64-sequence batch. embed_tokens is sharded over the columns (hidden dim) instead of replicated.
decisions.vae_batch: The Wan causal conv fuses its temporal front pad into the H-halo neighbor_pad, which asserts B==1 (measured TT_FATAL at B=2 on the H2xW4 split). The VAE therefore runs W-parallel over the 4 columns and batch-parallel over the 2 rows.
decisions.vae_decode_ceiling: 32 images per decode program fail in the allocator; 16 per program fit (9.27 GB live + 896 MB trace region). Re-tested after the last memory change.
decisions.exact_collectives: ttnn.all_reduce / reduce_scatter round float32 partials at bf16 level (7e-3..1.1e-2 abs measured). The transformer's row-parallel outputs and the precise text-encoder path use gather + fp32 add, which is exact.
decisions.text_encoder_precision: The Qwen2.5-VL towers grow massive activations (|x| up to 2.6e4) that amplify per-block error ~1000x on a few tokens (HF fp32 vs fp64 differs <0.4% there). The text-encoder ports run in a precise mode: fp32 biases (ttnn.add(fp32, bf16) rounds the sum to bf16), packer_l1_acc off (auto configs lost 3-5x with it on), explicit fp32 softmax, fp32 manual RMSNorm, fp32 RoPE, exact TP reduce. The vision matmuls are exact-lane (3 bf16 limbs x 8 lanes spaced 8 apart, median of 3 rotated partitions against rare tile glitches). The LM uses 2-limb dense products. Measured at B=32: min prompt-embed PCC 0.999978 (before: 0.973); text-encode stage 80 s.
decisions.vae_gate2: encoder3d / decoder3d route every child of the Wan stack through its graduated port (forward_sharded on the partitioned activation). zero_pad2d pads the bottom row explicitly before a valid-H conv; qwen_image_upsample is the x2 inside each decoder resample.
decisions.transformer_precision: Precise transformer mode (_stubs/_precise.py, on in the pipeline): 2-limb bf16 activations for every projection, float32 AdaNorm modulation and biases, exact-lane QK^T (median of 3 rotated partitions). Measured per forward at B=2, full depth: CFG noise PCC 0.99993 -> 0.9999956. Cost at B=32: 55 -> 120 s per denoise step.
decisions.text_encode_chunks: The 64 text sequences run as 2 programs of 32 (prompts, negatives). With the 896 MB trace region reserved, one 64-sequence program ran out of DRAM (a 704 MB allocation), measured.

results.root_cause: The 50-step CFG-4 trajectory is chaotic for some inputs. For samples 30 and 26 the reference itself does not reproduce above 0.99. For others, TT per-forward error (~100x fp32 rounding) is amplified over the trajectory.
